title: Sign in to Terma
description: Enter the Web access password. If only an access token is configured, enter that token instead.
setup_hint: First use: set a Web password in Terma on the device running the service. After signing in, you can change it in Settings > Security.
fnos_setup_hint: Use the Web password chosen during installation. To set or reset it, open fnOS App Center > Terma > Application Settings. This is Terma's own password; no username is required.
not_configured: No Web password or access token has been configured
invalid: The password or token is incorrect
temporarily_locked: The password or token is incorrect. Sign-in is locked for {{seconds}} seconds
too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds
